paper_metadata.title: Effects of V on the microstructure and mechanical properties of HfNbTaTiVx refractory multi-principle element alloys: A combined experimental and computational study

evidence.quote: a series of HfNbTaTiVx (x = 0.00–1.00) alloys were designed to investigate the effects of V content on the microstructural and mechanical properties of RMPEAs.

All DFT calculations were performed by using the VASP code with the plane-wave projector augmented wave (PAW) method to describe the ion electron interaction, and the generalized gradient approximation (GGA) to treat the exchange-correlation function.

attributes.composition: Ta and Nb enriched in dendrite regions; Hf, V, Ti in interdendritic regions

evidence.quote: the as-cast alloys have notable elemental microsegregations. High-melting-point elements Ta (3269 K) and Nb (2741 K) are enriched in dendrite regions (DRs), while low-melting-point elements Hf (2500 K), V (2193 K), and Ti (1933 K) are accumulated in interdendritic regions (IRs).
